name: JK BullP AutoTrader
summary: JK BullP AutoTrader is a trend-following Expert Advisor that identifies bullish momentum conditions and automatically enters trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It uses a combination of moving average confirmations and momentum filters to generate entry signals, with built-in stop loss and take profit management. The EA is designed for medium-term trading on higher timeframes.
summary_zh: JK BullP AutoTrader是一个趋势跟踪型智能交易系统，通过识别看涨动量条件并沿趋势方向自动开仓。它结合均线确认和动量过滤生成入场信号，内置止损止盈管理功能，适用于中高时间框架的交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于趋势跟踪原理，利用均线系统判断市场趋势方向，当价格处于均线之上且动量指标确认时做多。入场条件通常包括快速均线上穿慢速均线、价格突破关键均线以及动量指标处于有利区间。出场条件则依赖预设的止损止盈比例，也可能包含移动止损机制来锁定利润。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的动态手数计算方式。资金管理方面，EA提供风险百分比参数控制每笔交易的风险敞口。整体策略逻辑偏向保守的趋势跟随，但缺乏对震荡行情的过滤机制，可能在盘整市中产生较多虚假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is based on trend following principles, utilizing a moving average system to determine market trend direction and entering long positions when price is above key moving averages with momentum confirmation. Entry conditions typically include a fast moving average crossing above a slow moving average, price breaking through a key moving average level, and momentum indicators being in favorable zones. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit ratios, and may also include a trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits as the trade moves favorably. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or dynamic lot calculation based on account equity percentage. Money management is handled through risk percentage parameters that control the exposure per trade. The overall strategy logic leans toward conservative trend following, but lacks adequate sideways market filtering which may generate numerous false signals during ranging conditions.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号用于识别订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于趋势跟踪原理，顺势交易胜率较高
内置止损止盈和移动止损功能，风险控制较为完善
参数可调节性强，适合不同市场环境优化
使用魔术编号管理订单，避免与其他EA冲突
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on trend following principles with relatively high win rate when trading with the trend
Built-in stop loss, take profit and trailing stop functionality providing solid risk control
Highly adjustable parameters suitable for optimization across different market conditions
Uses magic number for order management preventing conflicts with other EAs
cons: 缺乏震荡行情过滤机制，盘整市中容易产生虚假信号和频繁亏损
未检测到点差过滤功能，在高点差环境下可能不利
缺少新K线检测机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓
回测数据不足，策略在不同品种和时间框架上的适应性未经验证
cons_en: Lacks sideways market filtering mechanism, prone to false signals and frequent losses during ranging conditions
No spread filter detected, which may be disadvantageous in high spread environments
Missing new bar detection mechanism, potentially causing repeated entries within the same bar
Insufficient backtesting data, strategy adaptability across different instruments and timeframes is unverified
improvements: 增加震荡行情识别过滤器（如ADX或布林带宽度），避免在盘整市中频繁交易
添加新K线检测和点差过滤功能，提高入场质量并减少不必要的交易成本
improvements_en: Add sideways market identification filters (such as ADX or Bollinger Band width) to avoid frequent trading during ranging markets
Implement new bar detection and spread filtering functionality to improve entry quality and reduce unnecessary trading costs

risk_points: 缺少新K线检测机制，可能在同一K线内重复开仓导致过度交易
未检测到点差过滤，高点差时段可能影响交易质量
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中可能连续亏损
risk_points_en: Missing new bar detection mechanism, potentially causing over-trading with repeated entries on the same bar
No spread filter detected, high spread periods may negatively impact trade quality
Trend following strategy may incur consecutive losses during ranging markets

The EA is designed for medium-term trading on higher timeframes.
